create_timeseries_from_names: create a TimeSeries from times, data, and a MuJoCo model by resolving signal names automatically
create_timeseries_from_custom_map: create a TimeSeries from custom data with explicit signal names, widths, and types
resample_timeseries: resample a TimeSeries to new timestamps or a target time interval using interpolation
slice_timeseries_by_name: slice a TimeSeries to keep only named signals with re-indexed contiguous columns
interpolate_timeseries: interpolate TimeSeries data at specified time points using linear, cubic, or zero-order hold methods
